title: Industrial Gas Accumulator
summary: Custom industrial gas accumulator vessel for pressure buffering and process service, based on the published project design data.
body:
Tongyang manufactures project-specific pressure vessels and gas accumulator equipment. This reference product is based on the published design data for an industrial low-pressure compressed gas accumulator. The final equipment configuration, materials, dimensions and scope must be confirmed against the approved project drawings and data sheet.

Technical Specifications

Parameter

Published design data

Equipment capacity

Approximately 6.55 m³

Design pressure

0.345 MPa(g)

Operating pressure

0.008 MPa(g) (top) / 0.015 MPa(g) (bottom)

Design temperature

220°C

Operating temperature

-10 to 110°C

Design code

ASME Section VIII, Division 1 (2021 Edition); GOST 34347-2017, Paragraph 7; project specifications

Process fluid

N₂ + HC (as stated in the published data sheet)

External pressure condition

Full vacuum

Corrosion allowance

3.0 mm

Hydrostatic test pressure

0.58 MPa(g) vertical / 0.63 MPa(g) horizontal

Insulation

Foiled mineral fibre, 40 mm

Installation

Outdoor

Design and Manufacturing Considerations

The published design data also specifies a 6-year equipment service life/turnaround period, seismic intensity of 5 points, and design wind/seismic references to SP 20.13330.2016 and GOST 34283-2017. These project-specific requirements should be rechecked against the governing project specification and approved calculations before manufacture.

Material selection, vessel orientation, nozzle arrangement, supports, lifting features, insulation details, inspection extent and documentation are subject to the approved drawings and purchase specification. The listed design conditions are reference data for this product and should not be treated as a universal rating for other accumulator vessels.

Applicable Standards

The source product data identifies ASME Section VIII, Division 1 (2021 Edition) and GOST 34347-2017, Paragraph 7. Certification, stamp applicability, code edition, inspection and third-party requirements must be confirmed for the specific order.

Request a Quotation

For a project-specific quotation, please provide the latest data sheet or drawing, process medium, design and operating conditions, material requirements, destination country, inspection requirements and required delivery schedule.

Important: Published reference data is reproduced for preliminary product information. Final design and supply shall be based solely on the approved project documents and confirmed contractual scope.
